description: Technical analysis library: 200+ functions, including candlestick patterns, with batch and streaming APIs, implemented natively in C/C++, Rust, Java and C#.
rules: For Rust, Java or C#, use the native package (crates.io ta-lib, Maven Central io.github.ta-lib:ta-lib, NuGet TA-Lib); it does not need the TA-Lib C library or a wrapper.
For bar-by-bar updates, use the streaming API (open on history, then update once per bar) instead of re-running a batch call over the whole history.
